decision_conditions:
This consent is valid for two years.

Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
TPO 02/89
T3(Acer pseudoplatanus) - Lift crown and suckers up to 3m
T6 (Quercus robur) - Remove deadwood. Reduce crown by 30%.
T13 (Mixed tree group) - Lift all growth over the road to 4m
T10 (Taxus baccata) - Sever Ivy at base of tree. Lift crown to 3m by removing subs suckers to base of crown. Remove growth roadside up to the height of adjacent lamp column. Remove 50cm of growth between 2.5 and 5m. Remove 1m of growth up to 2.5m.
T11 (Fraxinus excelsior) - Cut back 1m from building by removing sub-limbs. Cut back from private nearby garage.
T28.3 (Pinus nigra) - Lop by 8m below fork, due to lost limb lower on trunk.
T45 (Quercus robur) - Remove deadwood 5 pieces over path approximately 6 dbh and smaller. From 2 to 6m height. Longest is 3m (summary)
